_comment: WF v8 WP2 (research/v7/WF-V8-PLAN.md 'Gate', WF-REVIEW-opus.md C10) — the ruleOverrides the orchestrator adds to subjects/<s>/subject.json at a round boundary; WP2 edits no subject. Per subject, `ruleOverrides` is the exact JSON to add (merge its keys into an existing ruleOverrides). The names `wheels` and `paletteZones` extend the owner's 2026-09-26 TARGET WINS ruling: owner ratification pending. Measured on the committed gold models (HEAD 78d8269; `_gold` = git blob of out/ref/gold/<s>/model.mjs), re-checked on the round-5 commits (see _verify). Colours: node scripts/v7/measure.mjs sample --subject <s> --view concept|rear x,y,w,h, each rect inside the zone's visible pixels of the registered model render and checked on a measure.mjs grid crop; the rear turnaround view where the concept does not show the part. Wheel numbers: the chain's own wheel groups (kernel-chain chainContext + rules/vehicle.mjs wheelGroups) and measure.mjs runs on the side turnaround.
_verify: 2026-09-27, scratch copies of the five subjects (subject.json + these ruleOverrides, the WP2 kernel-chain / rules/vehicle.mjs): node scripts/v7/inspect.mjs chain --module out/ref/gold/<s>/model.mjs --subject <s> prints pass true on all five r4 golds (78d8269 blobs below) with RULE_OVERRIDE advisories only, and node scripts/check-module.mjs <m> --subject <s> PASS. Without them (the committed subject.json) all five print pass false: school_bus 3, pickup 1, taxi 10 PALETTE_ZONE; delivery_truck VEH_WHEELS (6 wheel assemblies), then 8 PALETTE_ZONE; tractor 2 VEH_WHEELS (diameters 0.911..1.505 m, diameter/length 0.355), then 5 PALETTE_ZONE. Round 5 (HEAD b3a62cd: school_bus cf538571, pickup 5ad5926a, taxi 51a4fd4c, delivery_truck ca273f28) keeps the same zones, palette colours and truck wheels: pass true with, pass false without. The tractor's round 5 was still uncommitted: see tractor._r5_working_copy.
